scientific_integrity: The proof is symbolic: an exact least-missing-prime bound on the length of a prime arithmetic progression is combined with the fact that the first composite is odd, so its largest prime divisor is at most one third of it. Finite computation is used only for regression checks.
scientific_limitations: The result is an upper bound for even parameters. It does not determine the exact number of cycles or settle the unbounded-loop question, and its arithmetic-sensitive bound is not uniformly smaller than every earlier numerical bound for each small parameter.
title: Even-parameter cycle bound from the least missing prime \(\rho(k)\)
